name: D&M Quality Maintenance
own_site_check_result: dmqualitymaintenance.com resolves to Google parking IPs (216.239.x.x, server: ghs) and returns Google's generic 404 page over HTTP; HTTPS connection resets (no TLS service configured). No active website is served on this domain. All other checked variants had no DNS record or no reachable host. No official website found in web search for the exact business name either. Confirmed: no own website.
review_count_note: The task brief stated 34 reviews; a live render of the Google Business Profile page (business.google.com/v/d-m-quality-maintenance/06004248881952706434/decd/_) during this research showed 52 reviews at 4.9 average. Used the current, directly observed number.

hours.source: Google Business Profile public page, rendered with a headless browser (Chrome user agent) during research. All seven days listed as 9 AM to 5 PM.

phone_verification: Confirmed directly from a `tel:+1-904-233-3419` link found in the rendered HTML of the live Google Business Profile page (not a search-snippet guess). Area code 904 matches Jacksonville, FL.

services_source: Combined from Google Business Profile service categories (Accessory building construction, Basement remodeling) and verbatim review content describing real completed jobs (kitchen/living area renovation, walk-in closet, 15-step staircase, bathroom flooring, bathtub-to-walk-in-shower conversion, wall crack repair) plus photo evidence from the Google Business Profile gallery (roof shingle repair, roof vent installation, exterior lighting install). No services were invented.

evidence: Phone area code (904) is Jacksonville, FL.
Google Business Profile public page lists service area as Clay County, FL; Duval County, FL; and St Johns County, FL, all within the Jacksonville metro area.
GBP description states the business is 'locally owned and operated' in Jacksonville, Florida, and is Verified.
Downloaded photos show Florida-style single-story homes, shingle roofing typical of the area, and a street sign/fire truck matching a Jacksonville-area residential street.

photos.source: Google Business Profile photo gallery (lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/... URLs), extracted from the rendered GBP 'full menu' page HTML, downloaded via curl with a Chrome user agent at =s1600, verified as real JPEGs with `file`, two images with sideways camera orientation corrected with PIL (rotate 90, EXIF-aware), all resized to max 1000px wide at quality 82.

build_variant: Adapted variant per PIPELINE.md Fase 3 point 5: no exact pricing (free estimate / call or text for a quote), no map (no published street address, a real roofing photo used instead), phone-based CTA (call + text to the real number), 4 real review testimonials instead of priced service listings.
notes: No email, Instagram, Facebook, Yelp, or other public contact channel was found beyond the phone number and the Google Business Profile itself. The GBP page is Verified and confirms the business is locally owned and operated. Review count (52) and rating (4.9) were read live from the rendered GBP page during this research session, which differs from the review count (34) mentioned in the original task brief; the live, directly observed number was used throughout the site and data.
